sparse_fit.estimator: RANSACRegressor(LinearRegression(), min_samples=max(2,n//2)) -- mirrors run_pipeline.py's fit_scale_shift_ransac (PR #34, merged into main), reimplemented not imported
sparse_fit.sparse_reference_provenance: The scale/shift PROCEDURE is deployable GIVEN GENUINE EXTERNAL REFERENCE ELEVATIONS -- it is exactly run_pipeline.py's --reference contract. The sparse reference elevations used IN THIS EXPERIMENT are simulated controls sampled from each scene's evaluation DSM (y = gt[rr, cc]), not independent field truth, not real GCP measurements, and not independently surveyed reference elevations. 'Deployable' describes the algorithm conditionally, never the provenance of these particular sampled values.
sparse_fit.b2_denominator_guard: EPS_DIVISION_GUARD=1e-06 m is a floating-point division safety guard only, not a methodological minimum-range cutoff. A seed whose 10 sampled points span less than this many metres (or a non-finite range) is marked candidate_diagnostic_evaluable=false / insufficient_evidence and excluded from pass/fail comparison.
